say:2:1320331001:1.text: Hmm? Aren't you the Flower Attendant we met earlier?
say:2:1320331001:1.source_cn: 咦？你是我们之前见到的那位奇花侍者吗？

say:3:1320331002:1.text: I think you have mistaken me for someone else. While you've been visiting Everstill Manor quite often lately, I've never spoken with you.
say:3:1320331002:1.source_cn: 我想应该不是。虽然诸位最近常来永寂庄园，但我从未与您搭过话。

say:4:1320331003:1.text: Oh, you do talk differently! The last attendant seemed rather timid!
say:4:1320331003:1.source_cn: 难怪你说话的语气不一样呢。之前那位侍者似乎很胆小！

say:5:1320331004:0.text: The timid flower attendant... Ah, you mean the one who organizes the painting tools.
say:5:1320331004:0.source_cn: 胆小的奇花侍者……啊，想必是几日前凋零的那位。

say:6:1320331005:0.text: He has been feeling a bit worn out lately, but don't worry, he's not near the point of withering yet.
say:6:1320331005:0.source_cn: 他最近有些疲惫，情绪也有些低落。但请不必担心，他还没有...

say:8:1320331007:0.text: Yes. Although His Lordship has granted us bodies and consciousness, we are still, at our core, everblooms. Even with prolonged life, withering remains the fate of every flower.
say:8:1320331007:0.source_cn: 是的。虽然子爵先生用魔法赋予了我们身躯与意识，但本质上...

say:9:1320331008:0.text: These are the words His Lordship told me, and I've done my best to remember them.
say:9:1320331008:0.source_cn: ——这些话是子爵先生告诉我的，我很努力才记下来。

say:10:1320331009:0.text: Strangely enough, His Lordship claims to envy us everblooms, believing that our eventual withering is something to be desired.
say:10:1320331009:0.source_cn: 不过，不知道为什么，子爵先生竟然说他很羡慕我们这些永寂...

say:11:1320331010:0.text: I still can't grasp that idea. His Lordship's thoughts are certainly quite intricate...
say:11:1320331010:0.source_cn: 这句话我到现在都没能理解。先生的想法总是很深奥……
